# Gitea (`go-gitea-gitea`)

Discover Gitea, your lightweight, self-hosted Git solution designed for speed and simplicity. Cross-platform and scalable, Gitea empowers seamless code collaboration for teams of all sizes. Try it today!

[Service documentation](https://docs.osaas.io/osaas.wiki/Service%3A-Gitea.html) · [Source](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "go-gitea-gitea"
  name       = "mygitea"

  parameters = {
    DatabaseUrl = "..."
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DatabaseUrl` | string | yes | Database connection URL for Gitea. Gitea supports multiple database backends including SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL. This URL specifies the connection string to your chosen database. |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
